title: 入障前状态与五档alpha配对：5×5自然切换
evaluation_role: Fixed-parameter paired mechanism DEV; original H75+Local300; no training
interpretation: 25 natural prefix/target schedules plus Zero and two duplicates; common original start; switch at original route progress2.5m; no restore
stop_rule: 12 declared contexts or runtime error; retain native terminations; no extra training/retry
primary_outcomes: original goal arrival and final hold

selector_protocol.features: normalized latest measured roll, IMUx, steering angle/rate, speed, path error, heading sin/cos, correction offsets/filters, requested speed; all from before switch
selector_protocol.rule: 3 nearest states in same terrain family, excluding the entire held-out physical group; rank mean task pass then normalized path/speed cost with failure penalty10 then smaller alpha
selector_protocol.roles: DEV only; not held-out terrain TEST
selector_protocol.stop: one finite bank; no parameter search or training
selector_protocol.paired_initial_tolerance: Report maximum XY/measurement pre-switch spread; only exact common switch tick and spreads <=1mm / .001 measurement units enter same-entry selector diagnostic; all episodes retained in overall results
